bestFor: Businesses needing to evaluate multiple options on the same criteria.
Decision-makers looking for structured decision-making tools.
Teams needing to ensure due diligence in business choices.
considerations: Ensure that the options and constraints are clearly defined to facilitate effective comparison.
Keep the audience in mind when framing questions and determining next steps.
entries.overview: The command effectively guides users through the process of evaluating business options, emphasizing the need for thorough evidence-based comparisons and clear procedural instructions for decision-making.
entries.summary: A reusable prompt for comparing options with the same criteria, primary-source evidence, a conditional recommendation and a concrete next check.
entries.title: Compare business options

bestFor: Connecting an agent to a self-hosted, normalized search service.
Reading retrieved sources through a consistent MCP tool interface.
considerations: Install the GitHub release artifact first; registry publication is separate.
Configure and authorize your own upstream providers; this listing does not prove their live availability.
Transport is stdio, with private credentials kept outside Git.
entries.overview: The existing open-source Search Gateway repository includes a real MCP stdio adapter for search and source reading. It connects to the operator's configured gateway or provider environment; this catalogue does not host that gateway or supply provider credentials.
entries.summary: A self-hosted search gateway with an MCP stdio adapter exposing web_search and read_sources across configured search providers.
entries.title: Search Gateway

bestFor: Reviewing a recommendation before stakeholder circulation.
Checking whether source dates and constraints support a comparison.
considerations: The caller must supply the draft and source context.
Does not perform specialist approval or external mutations.
entries.overview: An original subagent definition for reviewing a draft against its cited sources. It returns prioritized evidence gaps and scoped wording changes to its caller rather than publishing or acting on the brief.
entries.summary: A focused reviewer that checks a business brief for unsupported claims, unclear inference and missing proof boundaries before it is shared.
entries.title: Evidence editor

bestFor: Product and market questions that need a concise decision brief.
Comparing options without inventing capability or verification claims.
considerations: Requires source-reading tools for current research.
Read-only: purchasing, outreach and private-data disclosure require separate authorization.
entries.overview: An original research workflow for comparing business options against shared criteria. It asks the author to inspect primary sources, distinguish fact from inference, and keep material uncertainties visible in the recommendation.
entries.summary: Turn a business decision and public sources into a concise brief with a recommendation, clear unknowns and one useful next step.
entries.title: Research brief
